name: SyncPlay Chat
overview: Adds a persistent chat sidebar during SyncPlay sessions.
description: SyncPlay Chat adds a chat button during SyncPlay sessions and shows messages in a persistent sidebar with sender names for devices in the same SyncPlay group.

versions.changelog: Keeps the chat script inert until an actual playback page is present, adds a client-side version marker for cache checks, and avoids touching mobile group/join pages.
